name: cloaked-executioner-slow-without-class-bonus
notes: Cloaked Executioner (itwys9kf4r): Fast Activation is a [Class Bonus] clause. With the starting champion Spirit of Wind (no Assassin) it is a plain slow ally, so playing it from hand during player 2's main phase does nothing: it stays in hand and no ally enters.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] Fast Activation (only with the Class Bonus); otherwise slow speed.
